text: MCP server gives agents memory tools so they can decide when to save, look up, or update memories themselves.
quote: The Mem0 MCP server hands your agent a set of memory tools, so it can decide for itself when to save something, look something up, or update what it already knows.

text: Any AI client can connect to Mem0 through its MCP server in minutes.
quote: Connect any AI client to Mem0 using Model Context Protocol in minutes

text: An AI agent can create its own Mem0 account and API key with four terminal commands, no email or dashboard required.
quote: Let an AI agent create its own Mem0 account and API key in four commands, with no email or dashboard needed.

text: Mem0 Open Source is the same memory engine as the Platform, runnable on your own infrastructure with full ownership of the stack and data.
quote: Mem0 Open Source is the same memory engine as the Platform, running on your own infrastructure. You own the stack, the data, and every component

text: Self-hosted deployment ships a dashboard with per-user API keys and a request audit log for access control.
quote: The self-hosted bundle ships the REST API and a web dashboard together... per-user API keys and a request audit log.

text: Core API lets you store facts once and retrieve them later via query-based search.
quote: Store facts once, then retrieve them by query

text: Search accepts natural-language questions and returns the most relevant stored memories.
quote: Mem0's search operation lets agents ask natural-language questions and get back the memories that matter most.

text: Platform automatically builds a knowledge graph linking entities across memories, with no external graph database or schema to set up.
quote: Mem0 Platform builds a native graph linking people, places, and concepts across your memories, with no external graph database to provision.

text: Entity-centric queries like 'what do we know about Alice?' pull together facts from many separate conversations.
quote: You ask entity-centric questions like "what do we know about Alice?" and expect facts pulled from many different conversations

text: Memories can be scoped by user, agent, app, and session so they land in the right context.
quote: Scope conversations by user, agent, app, and session so memories land exactly where they belong.

text: Reranking reorders search results using deep semantic understanding to surface the most relevant memories first.
quote: Reorders results using deep semantic understanding to put the most relevant memories first.

text: Search supports filtered retrieval alongside semantic matching, not just a single fixed similarity search.
quote: Retrieve relevant memories from Mem0 using powerful semantic and filtered search capabilities.

text: Setting an expiration_date on a memory makes it stop appearing in search after that date without deleting the underlying record.
quote: Set an expiration date on a Mem0 memory and it stops surfacing in search once that date passes. Nothing is deleted.

text: Memory Export lets you generate structured exports of memories defined by custom Pydantic schemas.
quote: The Memory Export feature allows you to create structured exports of memories using customizable Pydantic schemas.

text: Webhooks deliver real-time HTTP notifications when memories are created, updated, deleted, or categorized.
quote: You can configure webhooks to send HTTP POST requests to your specified URLs whenever memories are created, updated, deleted, or categorized.

text: Official CLI supports adding, searching, listing, updating, and deleting memories directly from the terminal.
quote: The mem0 CLI lets you add, search, list, update, and delete memories directly from the terminal.

text: Documented setup guides cover 22 integrations, including LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, and the Vercel AI SDK.
quote: Setup guides for 22 tools, including LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, and the Vercel AI SDK.

text: Plugins let coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex remember project context via shared memory.
quote: Plugins that let Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other harnesses remember your project.

text: Python and JavaScript SDKs let you obtain an API key and save/search a memory directly from code.
quote: get an API key, then save and search a memory in Python or JavaScript

text: Mem0 automatically extracts individual facts from a conversation and stores each one separately.
quote: Mem0 pulls the individual facts out of the conversation and stores each one separately

text: A self-hosted REST server and dashboard can be stood up quickly with an admin account, API keys, and a live audit log.
quote: Stand up the Mem0 REST server and dashboard in a few minutes, with an admin account, API keys, and a live audit log included.
